description: AI-powered state expansion planning tool for OnCourse Systems for Education

stories.title: Create NCES data seed file
stories.description: Create src/backend/nces_data.py with real NCES data for all 50 states: total_districts, total_schools, total_students. Data year 2023.
acceptance_criteria: Each state has district, school, student counts

stories.title: Create Claude API service
stories.description: Create src/backend/services/claude_service.py with async Claude API client for AI-powered analysis. Include rate limiting and error handling.

stories.title: Create scoring service base
stories.description: Create src/backend/services/scoring_service.py with ScoringService class. Include methods to calculate and store scores for each factor.

stories.title: Implement district structure scoring
stories.description: Add district_structure_score() to scoring service. Score based on county-based (like LA=64 parishes) vs fragmented districts (like NJ=600+). County-based scores higher.

stories.title: Implement average district size scoring
stories.description: Add avg_district_size_score() to scoring service. Calculate avg_district_size from NCES data, score higher for larger districts (higher ARPU potential).

stories.title: Implement market opportunity scoring
stories.description: Add market_opportunity_score() to scoring service. Score based on total students and total districts from NCES data.

stories.title: Add NJ and LA baseline capabilities
stories.description: Create src/backend/baselines.py with NJ_CAPABILITIES and LA_CAPABILITIES dictionaries describing current supported features, data elements, submission formats.

stories.title: Implement technical fit scoring with AI
stories.description: Add technical_fit_score() to scoring service. Use Claude to analyze how closely a state's requirements match NJ/LA capabilities. Cache results.

stories.title: Implement development effort scoring with AI
stories.description: Add development_effort_score() to scoring service. Use Claude to estimate effort based on DOE website complexity and existing capabilities. This is the PRIMARY factor.

stories.title: Implement certification complexity scoring
stories.description: Add certification_complexity_score() to scoring service. Score based on whether state requires formal vendor certification vs open market.

stories.title: Implement competitive landscape scoring
stories.description: Add competitive_landscape_score() to scoring service. Score based on density of national/regional SIS competitors in state. Less competition = higher score.

stories.title: Implement geographic proximity scoring
stories.description: Add geographic_proximity_score() to scoring service. Score based on distance from NJ (current HQ). Closer states score slightly higher for support ease.

stories.title: Create score calculation endpoint
stories.description: Add POST /api/rankings/calculate endpoint to trigger score calculation for all states. Returns job status.

stories.title: Add ranking factor weight update endpoint
stories.description: Add PATCH /api/rankings/factors/{id} endpoint to update factor weights. Allows configuring ranking importance.

stories.title: Create ranking weights configuration UI
stories.description: Add ranking factor weights configuration section to /rankings page. Allow adjusting weights with sliders or inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Slider or number inputs for each factor

stories.title: Add state detail API endpoint
stories.description: Add GET /api/states/{id}/detail endpoint returning full state data including NCES data, all scores, and requirements.

stories.title: Create state detail page
stories.description: Create /states/[id] page in frontend showing full state details, scores breakdown, and NCES data.
acceptance_criteria: Shows state name and DOE link

stories.title: Add sorting and filtering to rankings
stories.description: Update /rankings page with sorting by any column and filtering by minimum score threshold.

stories.title: Validate NJ and LA rankings
stories.description: Write validation test ensuring NJ and LA appear in appropriate positions (LA should rank favorably due to parish model). Add test file.

stories.title: Create ranking methodology documentation
stories.description: Create /rankings/methodology page explaining all ranking factors, weights, and data sources. Include LA benchmark story.
